title: Bumblebee holding a heart
svg:

  <path d='M70 60 Q76 66 70 70' stroke='#4a3b8f' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 78 C38 68 32 70 32 77 C32 84 42 88 50 95 C58 88 68 84 68 77 C68 70 62 68 50 78 Z' fill='#ff5b8d'/>
